meta.title: Features
meta.description: Remote management, scheduling, 38 apps, offline playback, on-screen zones and your own branding — everything a screen needs.

hero.title: Everything a screen needs — and nothing that gets in the way.
hero.subtitle: EdgeRize pairs simplicity with control: build content in minutes, keep real power over your whole network of screens.

grid.title: Built to make the everyday easy.

items.title: Manage remotely
items.body: Change everything from your phone or laptop, from anywhere.

items.title: Scheduling
items.body: Content by hour, day or occasion — prepared in advance.

items.title: 38 apps
items.body: Menus, weather, exchange rates, news, calendars, social feeds.

items.title: Zones & layouts
items.body: Split the screen into zones and combine content.

items.title: Fleet management

items.title: Your brand
items.body: Colours, logo, fonts and layouts made to measure.

items.title: Any screen
items.body: Android or desktop, a regular TV or a pro display.

items.a: Yes. Change colours, logo, fonts and layouts so everything looks like part of your brand.
Yes. Prepare offers and announcements and run them exactly when they matter — by hour, day or occasion.

items.a: You group screens by location and publish to all at once or one at a time, from the same panel.
